**Changelog for anydocs v1.0.2**

- Added Python bytecode cache files (`.pyc`) for CLI and library modules to improve performance.
- No changes to Python source files or skill features.

fixed auto discovery

Version 1.0.1 - Security hardening release
   - HTTPS-only enforcement for browser rendering (mitigates arbitrary URL injection)
   - Virtual environment by default for safe installation
   - Explicit user confirmation for system-wide setup
   - Comprehensive security documentation and best practices
   - All tests passing

Initial release of anydocs: powerful, flexible documentation indexing and search tool.

- Indexes and searches any documentation site via CLI or Python API
- Supports sitemap and fallback crawling, with smart HTML content extraction
- Multiple search modes: keyword, hybrid (proximity), and regex
- Local smart caching with configurable TTL; profile-based configuration
- Optional automatic JavaScript rendering for SPA and dynamic docs (via Playwright)
- Commands for index building, searching, cache management, and profile setup
